_comment: Cards that exist only for the granted-blitz test (tests/unit/keywords/test_grant_blitz.py). Never part of a deck list; loaded by the test registry fixture alongside data/cards/. `t_blitz_granter` is Henzie "Toolbox" Torre's first line on a free body, so the grant can be put on the board without paying for the granter. `t_blitz_brute` is a {3}{R} creature, mana value 4 -- the boundary the filter names; `t_blitz_cub` is a {2}{R} creature one mana value under it; `t_blitz_bonfire` a {4}{R} sorcery, over the line and not a creature.

cards.name: Test Blitz Granter
cards.oracle_text: Each creature spell you cast with mana value 4 or greater has blitz. The blitz cost is equal to its mana cost.
